title: Go Concurrency & Data Races
description: A program can appear to work and still contain a data race. Use the race detector in your tests, and lint package-level globals to handle shared state more deliberately.

title: Modernise your Golang codebase
description: When coding or using a coding agent you must make sure to write codes which adhere to latest Golang standards. We and even coding agents do not always know everything So it is a good idea to automate this and for that we have Golang team to thanks.

title: Goroutine Leaks & goleak
description: Go happily compiles and runs code that never waits for its goroutines. Use goleak in your tests to catch the ones still running.
